parameters.content:
# BUYER SETUP GUIDE
## AI CA Firm Client Operations & Compliance Automation Suite

### Core services in this suite
- WhatsApp client support for existing clients
- WhatsApp lead capture & qualification
- Document request / document received tracking
- Compliance context lookup
- Email-based client support
- Automated follow-ups for leads/documents
- Internal error logging & admin alerts
- Google Sheets-based operational database

### Buyer credentials
Connect only buyer-owned credentials for:
- Google Sheets
- WhatsApp Cloud API / Meta
- Gmail or email provider used by the email branches
- Groq / configured AI provider
- Telegram (admin notifications, if enabled)
- Any calendar/document integrations used by the remaining branches

### Recommended environment variables
- `CA_FIRM_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`
- `CA_FIRM_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID`
- `CA_FIRM_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN`
- `CA_FIRM_ADMIN_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`
- `CA_FIRM_AI_MODEL`
- n8n variable `FIRM_NAME`

### Important
This workflow references multiple Google Sheets tabs such as Clients, Leads, Compliance_Calendar, Documents_Tracker, Query_Log and Error_Log. Preserve the required column names when adapting the database.

### Before activation
1. Connect all buyer credentials.
2. Configure Meta webhook URL + verify token.
3. Confirm the WhatsApp phone number ID.
4. Confirm Google Sheet ID and tab names.
5. Test one existing-client WhatsApp message.
6. Test one new-lead conversation.
7. Test one document submission flow.
8. Test email support/follow-up branches.
9. Test the error logging path.
10. Keep the workflow inactive until all tests pass.

The workflow is delivered inactive by default.

# CUSTOMIZATION, SAFETY & DATA RULES

### Brand customization
Set:
- Firm name
- Client-facing language
- Service categories
- Tone of voice
- Admin escalation destination
- Follow-up timing
- AI model

### Data handling
The automation uses client identifiers such as phone/email and operational records such as compliance and document status. Use buyer-owned data sources and restrict sheet/API access to authorized staff.

### AI boundaries
AI may explain general GST, ITR, TDS, ROC and tax/compliance information, but it must not invent client-specific due dates or document status. Case-specific or uncertain questions should be escalated to a CA.

### Outreach & follow-ups
Review local email/WhatsApp marketing, privacy and consent requirements before activating outbound follow-ups. Do not use the automation for indiscriminate bulk messaging.

### WhatsApp webhook
The workflow includes Meta webhook verification and acknowledgement branches. Do not remove these when configuring production webhooks.

### Error handling
The suite contains a workflow-level error path that logs errors to Google Sheets and can notify an admin via Telegram. Keep the Error_Log structure intact if you want those alerts to continue.

### Production testing
Use a test client/lead and a test phone number before connecting production client data.

# WORKFLOW MAP

### Client Support
WhatsApp / Email → identify client → load compliance + document context → AI response → send reply → log interaction.

### New Lead Intake
WhatsApp → capture prospect → create/update lead → qualification conversation → structured qualification → update lead record.

### Document Handling
WhatsApp document input → match pending request → mark received → send confirmation.

### Follow-ups
Scheduled branches check pending leads/documents → prepare message → send through configured channels → update follow-up counters.

### Monitoring
Any configured workflow error → structured error log → Google Sheets Error_Log → admin notification.

Documentation notes are intentionally unconnected; they do not participate in runtime execution.
